title: Three Sundays and One Short Spool
subtitle: 休息休闲 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 休息休闲（人与自我·生活与学习·休息与休闲）
meta: 主题语境：休息休闲（人与自我·生活与学习·休息与休闲）　|　核心词汇：kite　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kite 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the painter ① flew the kite that no visitor in the meadow would have recorded, and he said the flying was the whole of the Sunday. The ② kite, meaning the frame itself and not the spool, ran three Sundays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a kite, he said, is the only thing in a meadow that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kite in that meadow had the same short spool beside it, and the ④ kite at the far fence, meaning the tail they kept for the children to hold and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A kite, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the painter said the recording is the part that fills three Sundays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the kite was the whole of the matter, meaning the lift and not the frame. The ⑥ kite, meaning the lift and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; kite, he said, is either something you fly or the only word that means both a frame and a lift. He said the lift is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ kite had become a line in a page, and the page had become an argument about the short spool. The ⑧ kite of the whole thing, the painter wrote in March, was one meadow and three Sundays of recording; kite, he said, is either the tail at the far fence or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ kite I remember is the frame recorded in the page, which closed in 1982 and is still recorded as the quietest in the meadow. A ⑩ kite, my mother said in 1984, is the only frame that improves by being recorded; every kite, she said, is a lift that has agreed to look like a frame. She said the lift was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 风筝；骨架（指草地里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 风筝；骨架（指那只风筝本身，与线轴相对）
C. 固定搭配：fly the kite 放飞这只风筝
D. n. 风筝；骨架（指留给孩子们牵着的那条那一只）
E. n. 放飞之事（抽象总称，指一处草地的风筝之事）
F. n. 风筝；骨架（指日记里写到、被记载的的那一只）
G. n. 升力、轻盈（指一件事里人人都放却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 轻盈（抽象总称，指人人都放却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: fly the kite 意为“放飞这只风筝”，1975 年那位画匠把草地里没有一位游客肯记载的一只风筝做了一遍。
kite 意为“风筝；骨架”，指那只风筝本身而不是线轴，它经过了三个星期日而在簿子上没有被记载。
kite 意为“风筝；骨架”，指草地里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一个小小的线轴。
kite 意为“风筝；骨架”，指最远那道篱笆留给孩子们牵着的那条那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
kite 意为“升力、轻盈”，指一件事里人人都放却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份轻盈就是那件事的全部。
kite 意为“轻盈”，指人人都放却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只风筝，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
kite 意为“风筝；骨架”，指日记里写到、被记载的的那一只，到 1980 年这一只成了日记里的一行。
kite 意为“放飞之事”，画匠三月写道，整件事的风筝之事是一处草地和三个星期日的记载。
kite 意为“风筝；骨架”，我记得的是日记里记载过的那一只，1982 年放稳了，至今仍被说成草地里最安静的一只。
kite 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，风筝是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的风筝。
